m01:room.title: The Bank Motion Archive
m01:room.job: Say whether the cage was still moving when the drum stopped.

m02:room.title: The Brake House Analysis Bay
m02:room.job: Say how hard an upward trip may stop the cage without unloading the rope.

m03:room.title: The Rope Shop Metrology Room
m03:room.job: Find the load the drive model carries, with the rope's weight in it.

m04:room.title: The Winder Geometry Loft
m04:room.job: Find the hoist drum's rotational inertia from its mass and its shape.

m05:room.title: The Winding Drive Hall
m05:room.job: Say whether the planned start stays inside the winding motor's torque rating.

m06:room.title: The Energy Audit Workshop
m06:room.job: Find the energy one full lift takes out of the stores.

m07:room.title: The Ventilation Power Gallery
m07:room.job: Set the cruise speed the hoist may use beside the ventilation fans.

m08:room.title: The Brake Impulse Cell
m08:room.job: Say whether the warm brake stops a loaded cage inside the trip limit.

m09:room.title: The Cable Rail Workshop
m09:room.job: Say what the latch does to the governor's speed.

m10:room.title: The Capsule Drop Station
m10:room.job: Find the speed a supply capsule settles at in the borehole.

m11:room.title: The Coupling Test Shed
m11:room.job: Find the speed the clutch settles at, and the pull it puts on the trip latch.

m12:room.title: The Rope Dynamics Laboratory
m12:room.job: Model the hoisting rope as a spring, with its own mass counted.

m13:room.title: The March Landing Replay Room
m13:room.job: File a peak time before the sealed trace is opened.

m14:room.title: The Warm Brake Certification Cell
m14:room.job: Bound the worst-case stop above the bank landing.

m15:room.title: The Emergency Winding Control
m15:room.job: Put every signed limit into one winding plan and time it.
